title: Gambas al Ajillo
subtitle: Garlic prawns sizzled in olive oil
excerpt: Raw prawns cooked in a pool of garlicky olive oil with sliced red chilli and parsley, finished with a squeeze of lemon. This is a 10-minute dish that looks and tastes far more impressive than the time it takes. Serve sizzling in the pan or in small bowls, with crusty bread for mopping up the oil.
sourceNotes: Gambas al ajillo is one of Spain's most beloved tapas dishes; it appears across every region but is especially associated with Andalucia and Madrid, where it is served in small clay cazuelas with crusty bread for mopping.

content.text: Use the best olive oil you have for this: it is as much a flavoured oil dish as it is a prawn dish. The garlic slices should turn golden and nutty in the oil before the prawns go in; do not let them go brown or they will taste bitter. Raw prawns take only 2 to 3 minutes per side, so have everything prepped before the pan goes on the heat. Overcooking is the one mistake to avoid.

items.prepNote: half juiced, half cut into wedges to serve

content.text: Pat the prawns dry with kitchen paper and season generously with salt. Have the garlic, chilli and parsley all prepped and within reach before you start cooking.

Pour the olive oil into a wide frying pan and place over a medium heat. When the oil is warm, add the garlic slices and chilli. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until the garlic is golden and fragrant but not brown.
Increase the heat to high. Add the prawns in a single layer. Cook for 2 minutes without moving until they turn pink and curl. Flip each one and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more until just cooked through.
Squeeze over the lemon juice, scatter with parsley and serve immediately, straight from the pan, with lemon wedges and bread on the side.

items.cause: Overcooked; prawns only need 2 to 3 minutes total at high heat
items.fix: Remove from the heat as soon as each prawn has curled into a C shape and turned pink all the way through. A tightly curled O shape means overcooked.

items.symptom: Garlic has gone brown and bitter
items.cause: Heat was too high when the garlic went in
items.fix: Start with medium heat and watch carefully; golden is the target. If the garlic burns, discard the oil and start again; burnt garlic flavour cannot be corrected.
